name: Wikitext_MIA_benchmark_RH
description: Benchmark for evaluating membership inference attacks (MIA) on models trained on Wikitext-style language data. Measures how effectively an attacker can determine whether specific samples were part of a model's training set, across attack methods and model configurations.
evaluation_method: AUC (ROC), accuracy, precision / recall, and attack success rate for membership prediction
typical_sota_score: varies widely by model and defense; AUC often ranges from ~0.5 (random) to >0.9 in extreme leakage settings (reported results are dataset- and setup-dependent)
reputation: Niche, privacy-focused benchmark used by researchers studying membership inference and ML privacy leakage on language-models.
